changes: Highground enables the sniper crosshair for new installations and the Damage preset. `/hg setup` now offers separate target-marker and healer-marker choices before applying.

Healer crosses are green for friendly healers with a known role and red for known enemy healers. Enable friendly nameplates with Shift+V. Markers clear when nameplates disappear or the battleground ends.
The standalone addons receive maintenance updates; their features and saved settings are unchanged.
notice: After updating, /reload is enough; no full restart is needed. Existing Highground settings are kept: reapply Damage in /hg setup to enable its new crosshair default. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
